name: TrailingStop
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing open positions' stop-loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open any new trades on its own but manages already-opened positions by dynamically adjusting stop-loss distances. The tool is designed to protect gains while giving trades room to breathe through configurable trailing parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个移动止损工具，通过动态调整已有持仓的止损水平来跟随价格走势，从而锁定利润。它不会自行开仓，仅管理已存在的头寸，通过可配置的追踪参数动态调整止损距离。该工具旨在保护盈利的同时给予交易一定的呼吸空间。
strategy_analysis: 这是一个纯粹的移动止损管理工具，不具备自主开仓能力，仅对已有持仓进行止损跟踪管理。其核心逻辑是当价格朝有利方向移动超过设定点数后，将止损调整至保本或盈利水平，并持续跟随价格移动。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行开仓操作。出场条件为止损被触发时平仓，止损位置由追踪算法动态决定。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位大小计算，仅修改现有头寸的止损。资金管理方面，通过追踪止损锁定利润来间接保护资金，但本身不执行资金管理逻辑。该工具的关键参数通常包括追踪启动距离、追踪步长、止损偏移量等，用户需根据交易品种和波动性合理配置。
strategy_analysis_en: This is a pure trailing stop management tool that does not possess autonomous trade-opening capability; it only manages stop-loss tracking for existing positions. Its core logic is that when price moves favorably beyond a configured number of points, the stop-loss is adjusted to breakeven or profit levels and continues to follow price movement. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trade entries. Exit conditions occur when the trailing stop-loss is triggered, with the stop position dynamically determined by the trailing algorithm. Position sizing is not handled by this EA as it only modifies the stop-loss of existing positions without changing lot sizes. Money management is indirectly supported through profit-locking via trailing stops, but the EA itself does not implement money management logic. Key parameters typically include trailing activation distance, trailing step size, and stop-loss offset, which users must configure appropriately based on the trading instrument and its volatility characteristics.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损距离（点数），价格移动超过此距离后启动追踪
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in pips, activates after price moves beyond this

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪步长（点数），每次调整止损的最小移动距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing step in pips, minimum price move to adjust stop loss

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 初始止损距离，0表示不设置初始止损
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术号码，用于标识要管理的特定EA的头寸，0表示管理所有头寸
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种，false则仅管理当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: Apply to all symbols; false manages current chart symbol only

pros: 有效锁定已有持仓利润，防止盈利回撤过大
参数灵活可调，用户可根据市场波动性自定义追踪距离和步长
不自行开仓，风险可控，仅作为持仓管理辅助工具使用
pros_en: Effectively locks in profits on existing positions, preventing significant profit drawdowns
Flexible and adjustable parameters allow users to customize trailing distance and step size based on market volatility
Does not open trades on its own, keeping risk controlled as a purely supplementary position management tool
cons: 追踪止损可能因市场短期波动被过早触发，导致盈利交易提前结束
不具备自适应功能，固定点数追踪在高波动和低波动市况下效果差异大
仅管理止损不管理止盈，缺乏完整的仓位退出策略
cons_en: Trailing stops may be triggered prematurely by short-term market noise, causing profitable trades to exit too early
Lacks adaptive functionality; fixed-point trailing performs inconsistently across high and low volatility market conditions
Only manages stop-loss without managing take-profit, lacking a complete position exit strategy
improvements: 增加基于ATR的自适应追踪止损，根据市场波动性动态调整追踪距离
添加分批追踪功能，支持对部分仓位进行追踪止损而保留其余仓位继续运行
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive trailing stop that dynamically adjusts trailing distance based on market volatility
Implement partial trailing functionality allowing trailing stops on a portion of the position while letting the remainder continue running

risk_points: 如果追踪参数设置不当（距离过小），可能因市场噪音频繁触发止损导致反复亏损
不设初始止损时，在追踪启动前持仓可能面临较大浮亏风险
risk_points_en: If trailing parameters are set too tight, market noise may frequently trigger stops causing repeated losses
Without an initial stop-loss, positions may face significant unrealized losses before trailing activation

It does not open any new trades on its own but manages already-opened positions by dynamically adjusting stop-loss distances. The tool is designed to protect gains while giving trades room to breathe through configurable trailing parameters.
